:::{#exm-span-subspace}
#### The line in @exm-subspace is a span

The line $\mathcal{S} = \cb{c\,(1, 2) : c \in \reals}$ in @exm-subspace
is $\operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 2)}$,
so @thm-span-subspace gives a second [proof](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-proof) that it is a subspace.
Likewise, the plane $z = 0$ in @exm-span is a subspace of $\reals^3$,
because it is $\operatorname{span}\cb{(1, 0, 0), (0, 1, 0)}$.

:::
